endcard-analysis.presentationEvidence: Source-informed chosen native horizontal-mirror presentation for this body view only, selected from the original source correspondence declaration: 'Whole original135 bank mirrored relative to original90; twenty unique ordered distal faces, reversing source image order. No tooth/spoke IDs or source default amplitudes inferred.' This corrects the documented relative image order with the retained montage camera and complete chosen51 input unchanged; opposite-camera versus literal editorial reflection remains unobserved, not recovered source history. The input donor private-packet bank branch coupled-bank-tip-1-native-reverse declares native presentation and reversed station indexing in a different full-frame camera; it does not explicitly prescribe mirroring for this montage camera. Supporting FIT-only baseline diagnostic at exact Spin frame3429, t143.017875: rocker16 source x1559.697998046875 versus native x1639.8; within rect[1280,0,640,540], x becomes 3200-x, giving x1560.2. This single FIT supports, but does not independently establish, handedness; no CHECK is used for selection or ranking. The earlier two-FIT premise misidentified rocker11: original catalog and manual seed declare it CHECK, unchanged here; rocker11 and rocker20 remain independent post-selection CHECKs requiring fresh native GPU measurement. Original pixels, sourceImage/BGR hashes, PTS, roles, uncertainties, tracking and raw source-view identity/layout are unchanged. Pen-inset is a separate unmirrored layer with unchanged rectangle/warp/composite; no stage acceptance or full435 source compatibility is claimed.

sourceMeasurementLimits.endcardAllSecondLandmarks: Only whole/crop source landmarks are populated in retained rows. Endcard catalog contains independently locally measured source pixels for one reference exposure only; no per-second hard moving/fixed panel observations are fabricated.
sourceMeasurementLimits.guide: Exact camera and source-native landmark associations remain unobserved; chosen whole-machine framing baseline only.

sourceLayoutSeed.authority: Original independently measured endcardViewCatalog source pixels/roles/uncertainties. No camera/native projection supplies source observations.

method.objective: Minimize sum over all native BGR training pixels of ((1-alpha)*outgoing+alpha*incoming-target)^2, alpha in [0,1], no gain/intercept/gamma nuisance.
method.trainingPixels: ALL native 16x16 tiles with (floor(x/16)+floor(y/16)) modulo2=0; all3BGR channels.
method.heldOutPixels: ALL complementary native 16x16 tiles, excluded from alpha/OLS optimization. No resize, mask/ROI omission or residual-based selection.
method.incomingImage: One exact independently decoded final Spin montage exposure3450, including lettering, black background and all ordered9subviews. Never repeated9times in fit.
method.originalEstimatorCorrection: Archived outgoing was convex-gray alpha+intercept OLS; incoming was separately gamma+alpha. Their mixed pair is not one common two-coefficient OLS. Fresh free2coefficient OLS is reported separately without normalization.
